what.text: This page follows refugees from Ukraine living in Spain.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 251276 Ukrainian refugees in Spain, 4.8% of all Ukrainian refugees.
Germany, Poland, Czechia and the United Kingdom host more.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, at war level in every one of those years.
Before that it records armed conflict over Novorossiya territory, with the DPR and LPR, from 2014 to 2022.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025, after big changes between 2020 and 2022.
UNHCR's figure for Spain rose from 222544 at the end of 2024 to 251276 at the end of 2025, its highest.
Returns from Spain to Ukraine were highest in 2022 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in Spain only, and UNHCR adds notes to some of them.
People displaced inside Ukraine are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC, and their figures are never added.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
